'''2012 US Nationals Day 1 Peter Grouty DS Tatooine (Coruscant)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Peter Grouty]] at [[2012 US Nationals]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Tatooine (Coruscant)]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
